newsitem.title: CHINA: CITIBANK BUYS PRIME SPACE IN SHANGHAI.
newsitem.headline: CITIBANK BUYS PRIME SPACE IN SHANGHAI.

text.p: Citibank has agreed with the government-backed Shanghai Bund Buildings Function Transformation Corp to buy 507 square metres of prime space in Shanghai's historic Peace Hotel, it said in a statement.
The location faces Shanghai's Bund, the city's traditional financial district, the bank said in a statement.
It did not say how much the bank paid for the space.

Citibank would continue to use the location as a 24-hour Citicard Banking Centre, but may convert the space into a branch office if the need arises, Kenneth Liu, head of the bank's development division for Asia Pacific, said in the statment.
Citibank is among nine foreign banks to whom China has granted permission to conduct local currency business in Shanghai.
It has branches in China's cities of Shanghai, Beijing and Shenzhen, and representative offices in Guangzhou and Xiamen, the statement said.
